answer: Anchor each seat to physical place: every epoch it must sign its local mains-frequency (ENF) micro-fluctuations plus GPS from a tamper-evident sensor. Co-located boxes share one power grid, so their traces line up like forged ink under violet light, and a thousand clones in one datacenter on a single karst ridge collapse into one detectable site, however velvet-smooth their uniform front. Passing as 1,000 independent agents instead needs 1,000 dispersed premises on distinct grids, about $500/mo each, $500,000/mo for the farm versus one honest site.
